verdict.rationale: Clara ships a live llms.txt (probe HTTP 200), an LLM-optimized API reference at /llms-api.txt, markdown versions of doc pages that point agents to the llms.txt index, a dedicated agent-instructions page, and an OpenAPI 3.1 schema intended for function calling. First-party docs and independent probes corroborate each other, and every element of the story is covered.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
